seriesSection.title: M / O / D / X Four Series

series.name: Entry-Level Simulator
series.desc: All essential elements for basic fire training requirements. Two-story tower with single-story annex — the ideal starting point for building training capability.

series.name: Open Space
series.desc: Configurable as multi-room (office) or large open-span (warehouse) layouts. Two-story residential/industrial unit + single-story annex for multi-person team training.

series.name: Multi-Level Advanced
series.desc: Larger open-floor module combinations creating complex interior building environments for advanced training.

series.name: Full-Size Complex
series.desc: Multi-level training tower + residential/industrial units + annex — with custom doors, windows, breach points, burn rooms, and prop interfaces.

advantages: All-galvanized steel frame — corrosion resistant, ultra-durable
Open floor plan — walls, doors, and windows freely reconfigurable
Modules rearrange and stack — expand on demand
